summary: Verified change-list from iteration 3: custom gold cursor renders (.laba-cursor-dot + .laba-cursor-ring, body cursor:none), no floating particle elements on page, coffee menu uses local /images/coffee-latte.jpg, all audited links have correct hrefs, price-note reads 'SAR 200+ per person', language toggle shows 'العربية' in EN mode and 'English' in AR mode (with document.dir flipping ltr<->rtl and coffee items rendering in Arabic), and the new instant reservation-confirm modal appears after a successful POST with correct WhatsApp confirm href prefix, correct name/guests/date-time details, and the Done button closes it. Reservation was persisted (verified via GET /api/reservations).
critical_code_review_comments: Success toast still says 'opening WhatsApp to confirm' even though the flow no longer opens WhatsApp automatically — consider updating T.contact.success copy to reflect the new modal-only behavior.
Confirm.jsx builds waUrl before axios call which is fine, but if the POST fails the user still sees an error toast (correct); no modal shown (correct).
seed_data_creation: Created 1 reservation via UI: TESTFN1785654512 Confirm, guests=4, date=2026-08-07, time=20:00 — persisted in DB (visible via GET /api/reservations).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Every change item requested by the review passed. Cursor elements are conditional on pointer:fine — they exist in the browser Playwright uses. Confirmation modal has data-testid reservation-confirm, confirm-whatsapp, confirm-done, confirm-close. Toggle label uses 'العربية' in EN mode / 'English' in AR mode (bilingual convention: shows the OTHER language name).
